fields.headline: YOUR NETWORK HAS BEEN ENCRYPTED
fields.text:
Hello NCIA.

Your flight systems were only the warning. All files on your servers, workstations and backups have been encrypted. Shadow copies were deleted. Do not rename files, do not run recovery tools, do not call a recovery company. You will only lose your data.

To get the decryptor, pay the amount below and send your ID to our contact address. We will decrypt two files for free as proof.
fields.threatOfLeak: We have copied 214 GB, including badge holder records and your Airport Security Program. If you do not contact us before the deadline, it will be published.
